description.zh: 坐席账号名称，实例内唯一（登录名）
description.en: The name of the agent account. The name must be unique within the instance. This value is used as the logon name.

description.zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
description.en: The unique client request ID, used for idempotence checks. You can use a UUID to generate this value.
The display name of the agent.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The instance ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service instance. You can view this on the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.
The ID of the skill group to which the agent belongs.
The list of skill group IDs to which the agent belongs.
